page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; one marginal note at the right, beside the middle of the text block.

main_text.p: & hauddubiè eft fecutus. Deinde oblitus ipse uideris eius quam tradidisti uocis, Sacramentum notationis, nempe frequentissimè sumi pro ceremonia & ritu: quæ significatio familiarissima est Augustino. Tertiò, tu & is cuius memini, erratis plurimum in interpretatione particulæ, Res facramenti, apud Augustinum. Constat autem, Res facra-menti conti-net, quod in uisibile ap-pellatur.ipsum passim distribuere sacramentum totum, in Sacramentum, hoc est uisibile signum, & rem sacramenti, quam etiam uocat inuisibilem gratiam & uirtutem. Apparet hanc distributionem consentire cum illa Irenæi atque reliquorum, de re cœlesti atque terrena. Iam uerò uos rem sacramenti siue uirtutem à Christi carne siue corpore separatis: quod prorsus est & ab Augusti-ni, & totius ueteris Ecclesiæ sententia alienum.

Quisquis in Augustini lectione utcunq; est uersa-tus, & candidum adhibet iudicium, fateri coge-tur, Augustinū appellare Sacramentū, quod uisi-bile est: Re sacramenti, quod inuisibile: & hac modo quidè uocat ueritate, uirtute, gratia, inuisibile unctionem charitatis, fructuq; sacrameti: uerùm in Ioh.tract.26. disertè nominat carne & sanguine Christi: quod uisibile uerò, carnis & sanguinis sacramentū. In lib.Sent.Prosperi clarè quoq; italo quitur, & nominatim interpretatur rem sacramenti Christi corpus. Cur aūt ita uariè loquatur, causa in promptu est, q; uirtute, gratia & fructū carnis à carne non separet, quod uos facere conamini: utq; quod semel defendistis, ptinaciter tueamini, Augustini restè dicta peruertitis, ut rudib.faciatis fucū. Sed qui oculos habet minimè fascinatos, facile uidet & uim uos Augustino adferre, & uos à uobis

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "hauddubiè" is printed as one word and may be "haud dubiè"; "rudib.faciatis" is printed without a space. Printing errors left as printed: "sacrameti" (missing m) in "fructuq; sacrameti"; "uerùm" and "fucū" carry macrons as printed. The paragraph break before "Quisquis" is inferred from the line ending; the line above is nearly full, so this is uncertain. Possible hyphens or spacing at line ends in "coge-tur", "uisi-bile" and "uersa-tus" are kept as printed. The word "uobis" at the foot is a catchword. The marginal note is printed in italics, with its line-end hyphens kept.
